'''Landmines''' are devices that attack enemies by emitting a cloud, similar to [[cv:Dragonfire|Dragonfire]] in vanilla DF. They can harm other creatures in a variety of ways, including excessive heat, cold, or by releasing dust or acid.

==Obtaining landmines==
According to their descriptions, landmines can be obtained from the mountainhomes. It is unclear whether other races such as [[kobold]]s and [[orc]]s can obtain them. {{verify}}

==Mechanics==
Note that landmines can also harm each other, or even themselves (this is often accidental, resulting from an attempted attack on a creature within 1-2 tiles).

Upon "death", landmines leave no corpse, and are not butcherable. They also leave no usable body parts behind. However, they will leave behind a spattering of hydraulic fluid (which, being a contaminant, is essentially useless).

==Types of landmines==
There are currently nine types of landmines in Masterwork DF:
*[[Acid landmine]]s
*[[Dryice landmine]]s <!-- NOT dry ice -->
*[[Dust landmine]]s
*[[Fire landmine]]s
*[[Flash landmine]]s
*[[Frag landmine]]s
*[[Hellfire landmine]]s
*[[Ice landmine]]s
*[[Warpstone landmine]]s (see [[Warpstone]])
